purpose: Protocol descriptor for common LV/RV PV-loop phase segmentation and morphology-quality reporting. This is a data-only audit contract for a future runner.

officialCaseSet.role: Canonical diagnostic subject ids for future reports only.

rules: Use valve-state evidence first when available.
Use pressure/volume derivatives only as supporting evidence or fallback.
Label event-adjacent samples as transition before assigning core morphology phases.
Label missing or contradictory evidence as uncertain rather than forcing a phase.
reportingPolicy: Report all primary metrics with transition samples included.
Report all primary metrics again with transition samples excluded.
Report transitionSampleFraction and uncertainSampleFraction for each chamber and beat.

notModeledSignals.name: characteristicImpedancePaSecPerM3
notModeledSignals.description: Characteristic impedance is not explicitly modeled by the current runtime and must not be inferred from R/L/C/flow.

notModeledSignals.name: arterialReflectionCoefficient
notModeledSignals.description: Arterial reflection coefficient is not explicitly modeled by the current runtime and must not be inferred from pressure or flow shape.

phaseCoverageFraction.description: Per-beat sample fraction for each phase label.

transitionSampleFraction.description: Per-beat sample fraction inside the event guard band or mixed-evidence transition state.

uncertainSampleFraction.description: Per-beat sample fraction with missing, contradictory, or non-finite evidence.

pvLoopArea.description: Signed pressure-volume loop area per beat.

phaseNormalizedRoughness.description: Curvature-like roughness inside a phase, normalized by first-derivative variation plus epsilon.

phaseKinkCount.description: Robust count of slope/curvature outliers inside a phase.

samplingInvarianceDelta.description: Relative metric change across configured sampling modes.

eventCorrelationWindowHitFraction.description: Fraction of metric outliers aligned to valve, clamp, solver, or artifact event windows.

lvRvAsymmetryIndex.description: LV/RV difference for paired metrics, normalized by paired mean plus epsilon.

classificationLabels.stable-under-sampling: Metric interpretation is stable across sampling modes.
classificationLabels.sampling-sensitive: Metric interpretation changes across sampling modes.
classificationLabels.event-sensitive: Metric is dominated by transition/event-window samples.
classificationLabels.lv-rv-asymmetric: Finding is materially different between LV and RV.
classificationLabels.unclassified: The runner cannot classify from available evidence.

samplingModes.uniformBeatGrid: Beat-normalized uniform resampling, with interpolation recorded.
samplingModes.eventAlignedCore: Event-aligned core phase samples excluding transition guard windows.
samplingModes.coarseSensitivity: Coarser grid sensitivity report for sampling-only artifact detection.

guardrails: Do not change model equations, solver behavior, official case parameters, UI display smoothing, or package scripts.
Do not use resampling or smoothing as the primary evidence source.
Do not hide event artifacts by widening transition windows without reporting transitionSampleFraction.
Do not compare LV and RV with different formulas or sampling modes.
Do not convert diagnostic findings into official morphology pass/fail claims.
